Chapter 1165 - 26 Arrival Of The Peerless Great Saint (Request For Monthly Tickets At The Beginning Of The Month)

Chapter 1165: Chapter 26 Arrival of the Peerless Great Saint (Request for Monthly Tickets at the Beginning of the Month)

"So many treasures."

Lin Yuan glanced in all directions.

In the grand hall, countless treasures floated in the air.

These treasures, be they rare wonders or weapons, etc.

Each treasure was surrounded by the power of space-time, suppressing any strange phenomena from the treasures themselves that would have otherwise pierced the sky.

"Even an Invincible Great Saint couldn’t possibly own so many treasures..." Lin Yuan mused inwardly; each treasure in the hall was at the level of the Dark Sky Heart, each belonging to an Invincible Great Saint tier.

Various rare wonders, materials, and even many coveted great elixirs desired by Invincible Great Saints were neatly arranged in the corners of the hall.

"Naturally."

The Tomb Spirit said with pride, "How can His Majesty compare to those Invincible Great Saints? With His Majesty’s power, the many dangerous ruins of the Chaos Void have long been explored completely, thus yielding plentiful rewards."

"I see."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Chaos Void contains many ruins, the most famous among them being the nine great ruins like the Taiyuan Ruins.

These nine ruins are all associated with thirteen-tier time beings. When Lin Yuan was still in his home universe, the ’White Paper’ that could reduce dimensions erupted from the depths of the Taiyuan Ruins.

These ruins are filled with many dangers, yet also nurture countless opportunities; if one’s strength is adequate, exploring these ruins will undoubtedly be profitable.

"Among these treasures are thirty-three Invincible Great Saint-tier weapons, sixty-two rare wonders of the same tier..."

The Tomb Spirit continued, "Were it not for His Majesty distributing many treasures among his followers before his struggle to achieve the thirteenth tier, there would be many more now."

Although His Majesty Xuanhuang was hasty in deciding to strive for the thirteenth tier, he made many preparations.

To establish the Xuanhuang Kingdom, His Majesty Xuanhuang fiercely clashed with many Invincible Great Saints.

While His Majesty Xuanhuang was present, those Invincible Great Saints naturally dared not make a move; but if His Majesty Xuanhuang were to attempt reaching the thirteenth tier and remained in the shackles of time cycles for a long period.

Then, those Invincible Great Saints who had once harbored enmity against His Majesty Xuanhuang would certainly act to settle scores with the Profound Xuanhuang lineage.

Therefore, before striving for the thirteenth tier, His Majesty Xuanhuang dispersed many disciples and followers of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage.

"That is..."

Lin Yuan’s gaze scanned over each treasure in the grand hall but quickly fell upon the highest platform.

On it, there lay three weapons: a fist-sized seal, a golden suit of armor, and a golden sword.

These three weapons gave Lin Yuan a feeling different from the others; indistinctly, there was a sense of familiarity.

"Those are the Xuanhuang Seal, the Armor of Xuanhuang, and the Xuanhuang Sword, the life weapons crafted by His Majesty, and the strongest among the various weapons."

The Tomb Spirit spoke, "These three weapons are naturally yours as well."

Lin Yuan gazed at the Xuanhuang Seal, Armor of Xuanhuang, and the Xuanhuang Sword, already informed by the Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm about His Majesty Xuanhuang’s primary battle weapons.

Indeed, they were these three.

The Xuanhuang Seal is a suppression-type weapon; in the hands of His Majesty Xuanhuang, one seal can shroud the heavens, and even Invincible Great Saints dare not directly block it.

And the Armor of Xuanhuang further combines physical defense, soul defense, and mental will defense, truly an exceptional all-around defensive weapon.

As for the Xuanhuang Sword, it is an ultimate attacking weapon; in the hands of His Majesty Xuanhuang, the Xuanhuang Sword has extinguished not just one Invincible Great Saint’s flesh and soul.

Of course, extinguishing an Invincible Great Saint’s flesh and soul doesn’t imply completely killing them, but it definitely inflicts severe injury.

"These treasures are all mine... what if His Majesty later breaks free from the time cycles..." Lin Yuan hesitated slightly.

Other treasures aside, but the Xuanhuang Seal, Armor of Xuanhuang, Xuanhuang Sword are His Majesty Xuanhuang’s life weapons, similar to Lin Yuan’s Origin Clock.

What are life weapons? They are as bound as kin, equivalent to a familial relationship.

"Over thirty million Cosmic Eras have passed since His Majesty broke free from the time cycles..."

The Tomb Spirit shook its head gently.

The earlier the break from time cycles occurs, the greater the hope; surpassing a hundred Cosmic Eras sees hope considerably reduced, exceeding a thousand Cosmic Eras, there’s virtually no hope.

And to surpass over thirty million Cosmic Eras?

"Moreover, if His Majesty really breaks free from the time cycles, becoming a time being, would he even care about these things?" The Tomb Spirit said.

"True."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Indeed so.

Even if His Majesty Xuanhuang escapes the time cycles in the future, with the status of a thirteen-tier time being, he likely wouldn’t regard these treasures.

"Then I won’t hold back."

Lin Yuan promptly gathered up the numerous treasures within the grand hall.

The Tomb Spirit watched quietly without any hindrance.

Ultimately.

After hesitating for a while, the Tomb Spirit still spoke, "As for the supreme treasure by which His Majesty left the suppression of time cycles..."

The Tomb Spirit reached out, and a Xuanyellow bead appeared before him.

"Is this the supreme treasure?"

Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn; he speculated the final supreme treasure His Majesty obtained likely relates to the thirteen-tier time being, otherwise, it wouldn’t require the power of time cycles to suppress.

"No."

The Tomb Spirit shook its head.

"No?"

Lin Yuan was slightly puzzled; wasn’t the Xuanyellow bead the supreme treasure?

Then why did the Tomb Spirit specifically bring it out?

"But as long as this bead is crushed, it can yield that supreme treasure." After a long silence, the Tomb Spirit finally spoke.

This was an order given to him by His Majesty Xuanhuang before his struggle for the thirteenth tier, as the ’spirit’ created by His Majesty Xuanhuang.

The Tomb Spirit cannot disobey any order from His Majesty Xuanhuang.

"Crush it, and you can gain that supreme treasure?"

Lin Yuan was very curious, scrutinizing the Xuanyellow bead closely.

In a vague sense, Lin Yuan perceived this bead to be suffused with the power of time, albeit incredibly weak.

"Indeed."

The Tomb Spirit nodded before saying, "However... I hope you refrain from crushing it for now."

"That treasure holds great importance; even His Majesty relied on the thirteenth-tier breakthrough coupled with descending time cycles to temporarily suppress it. If you crush it prematurely, danger may arise."

The Tomb Spirit looked at Lin Yuan, "Moreover, I personally, that is, me personally, do not wish for you to crush it too quickly."

His Majesty Xuanhuang’s original command left for him was to crush the yellow bead immediately once the successor arrived and inherited everything.

But the Tomb Spirit instinctively did not want to do this, knowing what it signified.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He could discern that the Tomb Spirit was reluctant to have this yellow bead crushed.

Although unaware of the reasons, Lin Yuan did not plan to act contrary. His journey to the Xuanhuang Universe had already yielded ample rewards.

The numerous mystical treasures outside the tomb, and so many treasure weapons within, including His Majesty Xuanhuang’s main battle weapon—all had been gained.

Lin Yuan was already quite satisfied.

As for that supreme treasure acquired by His Majesty Xuanhuang?

The fact that it compelled His Majesty Xuanhuang to advance prematurely to the thirteenth tier implies its significance. Even if the Tomb Spirit asked him to crush the yellow bead now.

Lin Yuan would consider it cautiously and, finally, most probably choose not to crush it.

Even if he had to crush it, he would wait until he stepped into the Chaos Realm or thoroughly cultivated to the peak of the Chaos Realm.

With Lin Yuan’s foundation, if he cultivates to the peak of the Chaos Realm, he may not necessarily reach the Invincible Great Saint level, but it would probably be close. With a little more accumulation, he would become the strongest Invincible Great Saint in the history of Chaos Void.

"Alright, this tomb is also a weapon. You can refine it now," the Tomb Spirit spoke, "After refining, leave the Xuanhuang Universe quickly."

"Leave the Xuanhuang Universe?"

Lin Yuan vaguely sensed that ever since this tomb manifested, the deep-seated space-time collapse of the Xuanhuang Universe seemed to hasten.

"Okay."

Lin Yuan nodded.

...

Meanwhile.

Outside the Xuanhuang Universe.

The Chaos Venerables haven’t left.

Though they dare not enter, they want to wait outside for a while longer.

To see when the mysterious Galaxy Great Saint would emerge.

Suddenly.

A remote space-time silently began to permeate with an enigmatic aura.

This aura made the rules of the Chaos Void retreat and form a completely new set of rules, distinct from those of Chaos Void.

"This?"

"What’s happening?"

"I can’t sense the external rule fluctuations?"

"Why does it feel like new unexplored fluctuations are emerging."

"Has a peerless Great Saint arrived by a thought turning into void?"

The many Chaos Venerables’ expressions changed drastically. The standing of a peerless Great Saint can form a world of its own rule domain, in which the peerless Great Saint creates rules favorable to oneself.

For example, the peerless Great Saint rule within a domain world disallows void traversing; so void traversing becomes impossible.

Of course, the rules set by the peerless Great Saint must also be followed by themselves; enemies cannot traverse the void, and neither can the peerless Great Saint.

Despite such limitations, these means of reversing rules put the strength of peerless Great Saints beyond that of Chaos Great Saints.

"Hmm?"

"Is it them two?"

In distant twisted space-time, the Eye of Myriad Laws and other special entities sensed something and gazed toward distant space-time.

"Weren’t these two always in a deep slumber?"

"Yes, I recall they had a grudge with His Majesty Xuanhuang."

"After over thirty million Cosmic Eras, still planning for revenge?"

The halved long blade spoke, somewhat surprised.

Most peerless Great Saints and even the Chaos Great Saints eventually choose to advance to the thirteenth tier.

But still a minority of peerless Great Saints choose not to, opting instead to sleep through Cosmic Eras.

"Choosing revenge over advancing to the thirteenth tier?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws also looked from afar.

...

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

Star Tear Fragment World.

Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit sat cross-legged.

At this moment, Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes.

"Is the Pavilion Master of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion seeking me?"

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred subtly as the Pavilion Master of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, seeking audience outside, appeared before him.

"Galaxy."

The Pavilion Master of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion opened an eye suddenly in the middle of the brow, its pupil a pale gold, exuding an air of supremacy.

"Eye of Myriad Laws."

Lin Yuan’s expression turned slightly stern, immediately realizing the Pavilion Master standing before him was possessed by the Eye of Myriad Laws; who now appeared had to be the Eye of Myriad Laws itself.

"What business do you have with me?"

Lin Yuan asked solemnly.

The personal visit of the Eye of Myriad Laws surely signified major happenings.

"You should still be inside the Xuanhuang Universe, correct?"

"Yes."

Lin Yuan nodded.

"Leave quickly."

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan.

"Two peerless Great Saints are proceeding there."
